# Marius Manolachi

Personal site of Marius Manolachi, AI consultant and builder. He helps companies train their teams, implement AI workflows, and create custom AI solutions they can own.

- Blog: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com/blog

- Sitemap: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com/sitemap.xml

Write about the questions companies ask while learning, adopting, and implementing AI: use cases, architecture, workflow implementation, evaluation, team capability, custom solutions, and when to hire help. One query per page. Cite the Quick Answer and named sources. Do not invent clients or results. Attribute firsthand teaching and shipping only from the public facts on /about.
